On October 28, 2026, Oracle described Abilene as close to completion [e2]. Neither update establishes full-campus commissioning or confirms that the forecast's assumed construction pace persisted [e1, e2]. These updates therefore do not settle the conditional forecast [e1, e2].
limitations: The evidence does not establish full-campus commissioning by the evaluation date; it also does not prove that none occurred.
The baseline construction pace and its persistence remain unverified.
The precise 7.1GW portfolio, campus boundaries and capacity measures remain unresolved.
Both timing tests fall after the October 28, 2026 evaluation date.

statement.excerpt: As I’ve discussed before, Oracle is building 7.1GW of total capacity for OpenAI, and keeps — laughably! — saying 2027 or 2028, when at this rate, Stargate Abilene won’t be done until mid-2027, and the rest either never get finished or are done in 2030 or later.
statement.document_title: Where Are All The Data Centers?

from_speaker: Oracle is building 7.1GW of total capacity for OpenAI
Stargate Abilene won’t be done until mid-2027
the rest either never get finished or are done in 2030 or later
our_interpretation: Done means full commissioning of the relevant campus scope, not the opening of a building or delivery of some GPUs.
The at-this-rate qualification is retained as a condition that the construction and commissioning pace underlying the prediction persists.
For Abilene, mid-2027 is provisionally treated as June through August 2027; a completion within that window would require review of the date ambiguity.
The remaining-sites clause predicts no full completion before January 1, 2030. It does not promise completion by the end of 2030.
The horizon ends on the last day before 2030 for testing that lower-bound claim; it is not a deadline for eventual completion.
The ordinary reading of the rest applies to the other Oracle/OpenAI campuses in the stated portfolio, but the precise portfolio requires reconciliation.
criteria.support_condition: With the pace condition established, Abilene does not reach full commissioning before mid-2027 and none of the other covered campuses reaches full commissioning before 2030.
criteria.contradiction_condition: With the pace condition established, dated records show Abilene fully commissioned clearly before mid-2027, or another covered campus fully commissioned before 2030.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Define the covered portfolio and campus boundaries, establish whether the pace condition held, and obtain dated commissioning or customer acceptance records. With that condition established, full completion of Abilene clearly before mid-2027 or another covered campus before 2030 would contradict the applicable clause. Support requires records establishing no full completion before the respective boundaries.
